<style>

<script type="text/javascript">
    function OpenSearch() {
        var what = document.getElementById("txtWhat").value;
        var where = document.getElementById("txtWhere").value;

        if (!what && !where) {
            alert("Please enter what you're looking for or where you want to search.");
            return false;
        }

        // Keep URL parameter readable; destination page can parse q
        window.location = "/searchresults.aspx?q=" + encodeURIComponent((what || "") + " " + (where || ""));
        return false;
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        // Enter key support for search
        document.querySelectorAll('.search-input').forEach(function (input) {
            input.addEventListener('keypress', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    OpenSearch();
                }
            });
        });

        // Animate stats on scroll
        const observerOptions = { threshold: 0.5, rootMargin: '0px 0px -100px 0px' };
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.style.animation = 'fadeInUp 0.6s ease-out forwards';
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        // Observe all cards (same scope as observer to avoid ReferenceError)
        document.querySelectorAll('.stat-card, .category-card, .classified-card').forEach(card => observer.observe(card));

        // Add CSS animation
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.textContent = `
            @keyframes fadeInUp {
                from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); }
                to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
